name: HR can export the filtered requests as a CSV file

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'hr@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Open the 'All Requests' page via the sidebar link (URL /hr/requests).
A CSV file download is triggered (a downloaded file whose name starts with 'leave-requests-' and ends with '.csv').
